title: DECEPTIVE AI SYSTEMS THAT GIVE EXPLANATIONS ARE MORE CONVINCING THAN HONEST AI SYSTEMS AND CAN AMPLIFY BELIEF IN MISINFORMATION
reasoning: The paper investigates the psychological impact of AI-generated deceptive explanations on human beliefs and misinformation. While it touches on truth and deception—topics with ethical dimensions—it focuses on cognitive reflection, logical reasoning, and persuasion rather than evaluating religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or formal ethical frameworks.
